name: Guardian Rose
text:
Activate F (concentrate)

Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

---
This rose-shaped crystal brooch is a translucent bloodred. These talismans have saved the lives of many a soldier on the field of battle. When you activate a guardian rose, you avoid being knocked out and regain 2d8+5 healing Hit Points. However, this puts a strain on your body and you are Enfeebled 1 until the end of your next turn.
